recovered_semantics.initial_peers: One random agent; self-selection redirected to adjacent index.

source_level_defects.finding: Single-candidate branch returns loop variable key (last enumerated key), not the sole oldest candidate. May evict a non-oldest message depending on enumeration order.

Multiple-peer random bound excludes final enumerated eligible peer.
Multiple-freshest random bound excludes final tied candidate.
